Read a manim.cfg file

Source: R/output.R
digest_config_file.Rd

Applies the settings of a .cfg file written for Manim, the format of upstream's manim.cfg: the [CLI] section holds settings such as quality, media_dir, background_color or format, and the [video_encoder], [video_encoder.options], [media] and [jupyter] sections their counterparts. This is upstream's config.digest_file(), also available as config$digest_file().

Usage

digest_config_file(filename)

config_file_paths()

Arguments

filename

Path to the .cfg file.

Value

digest_config_file() returns the settings applied, invisibly; config_file_paths() a named character vector.

Details

As upstream does on import, manimR reads two files when it is loaded, if they exist: the user wide file and the folder wide manim.cfg of the working directory, in that order. config_file_paths() gives their locations: ~/.config/manim/manim.cfg (on Windows ~/AppData/Roaming/Manim/manim.cfg) and manim.cfg. Upstream's library wide defaults are built into manimR. manim_cli() reads the working directory's file again, or the one given with -c/--config_file.

Examples

cfg_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".cfg")
writeLines(c("[CLI]", "frame_rate = 24", "background_color = WHITE"), cfg_file)
old <- manim_config()
digest_config_file(cfg_file)
config$frame_rate
#> [1] 24
do.call(manim_config, old[c("frame_rate", "background_color")])
